title: Open-label, Phase I study of NeoVax with Nivolumab in Patients with Ovarian Cancer
description: Personalized neoantigen-targeting cancer vaccines (PCV) in the adjuvant setting are of increasing interest across malignancies. Herein, we report the results of a first-in-disease phase I clinical trial testing the feasibility and safety of PCV for high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer (HGOC). 'NeoVax' consisted of pools of synthetic long peptides targeting patient-specific neoantigens admixed with the immunostimulant poly-ICLC, was combined with delayed administration of anti-PD-1 antibody, and was tested in 10 patients (one newly diagnosed patient (Cohort A) and 9 patients at first recurrence (Cohort B)) with platinum-sensitive OC following standard-of-care (SOC) platinum doublet chemotherapy.
